Type: three-seat slipcovered sofa
Use: seating, lounging, family gatherings; living room, family room, den
Style: classic, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: removable woven fabric slipcover, thick padded cushions
Colors: medium dark grey, cool grey
Shape: rolled scroll arms, three loose back and seat cushions, pleated skirt down to the floor, deep soft seat, rounded and generous
Feel: cozy, relaxed, homey, sturdy
Goes with: warm wood, white or cream walls, patterned cushions, brass accents; classic, traditional or farmhouse living rooms

product.name: EKTORP
product.description: Seat cushions filled with high resilience foam and polyester fibre wadding give comfortable support for your body, and easily regain their shape when you get up.
